title: grafana-data package: responsibility & ownership split
answers: Why do conventions differ between subfolders of grafana-data?
body:
packages/grafana-data is the shared pure-logic/type foundation used by grafana core, @grafana/* packages, and all datasource/panel plugins: DataFrame/Field model, field display/formatting, field-config overrides, transformations, theming, date/time handling, and base plugin classes (src/panel/PanelPlugin.ts). It has React as a dep but is the layer under @grafana/ui, not UI-heavy itself.
It is NOT owned by one squad: .github/CODEOWNERS (lines ~549-622) splits ownership per subdirectory — dataframe/, geo/, table/, text/, vector/ → dataviz-squad; field/, panel/, valueFormats/ → dashboards-squad; transformations/ → datapro; rbac/ → access-squad; types/, datetime/, themes/, and src/index.ts itself → grafana-frontend-platform.
Public export surfaces are declared in package.json's `exports` map: src/index.ts (~180 exports, the stable @grafana/data API), src/unstable.ts (internal-only APIs explicitly documented as forbidden for community plugins), and test/index.ts (mock helpers under @grafana/data/test, e.g. test/helpers/fieldConfig.ts, test/helpers/pluginMocks.ts).
